LOW_CazadorPalace_Kennel_Skeleton
Godey is an Undead Skeleton in the service of Cazador Szarr.
“
If I had my way, I'd saw off your legs - that'd put a stop to your wandering.
„
— Godey

Involvement

Godey is in the kennels of the Szarr Palace where he tortures Vampire spawn for Cazador. The kennels are on the lowest floor of the palace, just around the corner from the bottom of the stairs. The door is disguised as red and gold wallpaper in an arch on the wall. If the party fail their Perception checks, the room can still be accessed by lighting the brazier immediately north of the room (to the left of the door) at X: -1293 Y: 989.

If the party enter the kennels, Godey confronts them. If  Astarion is present, Godey mocks him and reminisces on all the times he tortured him. If defeated, Godey drops a  Szarr Family Ring, which can open various doors throughout the palace.

Godey can be persuaded to hand over the ring willingly by passing a  DC 15 Deception or Intimidation Check, followed by a  DC 20 Persuasion, Deception, or Intimidation Check. Passing both checks awards 95 XP. If the party kill him afterwards, the full 210 XP can still be gained.
